title: Palo Alto Networks security advisory (AV26-1056)
content_md: Serial number: AV26-1056 Date: October 16, 2026 As of October 15, 2026, Palo Alto Networks is affected by a vulnerability in the following product: Idira Secrets Manager (Self-Hosted) Prior to v13.9.1 The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web links and apply any necessary updates as they become available. Idira Secrets Manager - Version 13.9.1 Palo Alto Networks Security Advisories Article Link: Palo Alto Networks security advisory (AV26-1056) - Canadian Centre for Cyber Security
